usage.outputShape: body.best_flights[] and body.other_flights[] (each with .flights[], .price, .total_duration, .departure_token, .booking_token), body.price_insights, body.search_metadata
quirks: type=1 round-trip (requires return_date), type=2 one-way, type=3 multi-city
For round-trip you MUST also pass return_date or the call errors
Each flight result carries a departure_token; pass it to GET /api/google-flights/booking to get booking_options ($0.02 each)
Airport IDs are IATA codes (JFK, LAX); optional params: travel_class, adults, stops, currency
usage.guide: GET https://stabletravel.dev/api/google-flights/search with query params departure_id, arrival_id, outbound_date (YYYY-MM-DD), and type (1=round-trip, 2=one-way, 3=multi). For round-trip add return_date. Pay $0.02 via x402 on Base, fully synchronous — the JSON body comes straight back. Read flight options from body.best_flights[] and body.other_flights[] (price in .price, segments in .flights[]), and pricing context from body.price_insights. To get bookable links, take a result's departure_token and call GET /api/google-flights/booking?departure_token=... (another $0.02).
